prompt: How long did it take to build the Empire State Building?
hint: From the start of construction to opening day.
fact: Construction rose at an average rate of more than four and a half floors each week.

prompt: How long did it take to build the Eiffel Tower?
hint: From the first work on the foundations to completion.
fact: The tower was completed for the 1889 Exposition Universelle in Paris.

prompt: How long did it take to build the Burj Khalifa?
hint: From the foundation work to its opening.
fact: The Burj Khalifa opened in 2010 and remains the tallest completed building.

prompt: How long did the main U.S. construction of the Panama Canal take?
hint: Count the main American construction period.
fact: The canal opened in 1914 after French and American construction efforts.

prompt: How long did it take to build the Channel Tunnel?
hint: Use the construction period before its public opening.
fact: The tunnel links England and France beneath the English Channel.

prompt: How long did it take to build the Golden Gate Bridge?
hint: From the beginning of construction to opening day.
fact: The bridge opened in 1937 after a construction project of roughly four years.

prompt: How long did it take to build Hoover Dam?
hint: From the first concrete work to completion.
fact: Hoover Dam was completed two years ahead of its original schedule.

prompt: How long did it take to build the Sydney Opera House?
hint: From the start of construction to its opening.
fact: The building opened in 1973 after a much longer project than first planned.

prompt: How long is the commonly cited estimate for building the Great Pyramid of Giza?
hint: Think in decades, not centuries.
fact: The Great Pyramid remained the tallest human-made structure for millennia.

prompt: How long did construction of the Taj Mahal complex take?
hint: Use the often-cited period for the main complex.
fact: The mausoleum was commissioned by Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal.

prompt: How long did Apollo 11 take to reach lunar orbit?
hint: From launch to lunar orbit insertion.
fact: Apollo 11 travelled roughly 384,400 kilometres before entering lunar orbit.

prompt: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
hint: From the Sun to Earth at the speed of light.
fact: We always see the Sun as it was more than eight minutes ago.

prompt: How long did Voyager 1 take to reach Jupiter?
hint: From launch to closest approach.
fact: Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and is now the most distant human-made object.

prompt: How long does the International Space Station take to orbit Earth?
hint: One trip around the planet.
fact: The station sees roughly 16 sunrises and sunsets every day.

prompt: How long does light take to travel from the Moon to Earth?
hint: Use the average Earth–Moon distance.
fact: The Moon is close enough that a radio signal makes the round trip in about 2.5 seconds.

prompt: How long can a one-way radio signal from Earth to Mars take?
hint: Use a typical middle-of-the-range distance.
fact: The delay changes as both planets move around the Sun.

prompt: How long does Earth take to orbit the Sun?
hint: One sidereal year is close to, but not exactly, 365 days.
fact: The extra quarter day is why leap-year rules are needed.

prompt: How long does the Moon take to orbit Earth relative to the stars?
hint: Use the sidereal orbital period.
fact: The Moon’s orbital period and rotation period are almost identical.

prompt: How long does Pluto take to orbit the Sun?
hint: This is measured in Earth years.
fact: Pluto’s orbit is much more eccentric and tilted than the major planets’ orbits.

prompt: How long did a Space Shuttle launch typically take to reach orbit?
hint: From liftoff to orbital insertion.
fact: The shuttle accelerated from rest to orbital speed in only a few minutes.

prompt: How long did the longest tennis match in history last?
hint: The 2010 Wimbledon match between Isner and Mahut.
fact: The match lasted three days and its final set took more than eight hours.

prompt: How long is the official men’s marathon world record?
hint: Use Kelvin Kiptum’s 2023 record.
fact: A marathon is exactly 42.195 kilometres long.

prompt: How long is regulation football (soccer) match time?
hint: Ignore stoppage time and halftime.
fact: A match has two 45-minute halves separated by halftime.

prompt: How much playing time is in a regulation NBA game?
hint: Count four quarters, excluding breaks and overtime.
fact: The NBA uses four 12-minute quarters.

prompt: How long can a scheduled Test cricket match last?
hint: Use the maximum scheduled playing period.
fact: Test matches include scheduled rest days and can still end without a winner.

prompt: How long does the Tour de France typically last?
hint: Count the race’s stages and rest days.
fact: The race usually includes 21 stages and two rest days.

prompt: How long is the men’s 100-metre world record?
hint: Use Usain Bolt’s world record.
fact: Bolt set the record at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin.

prompt: How long did the longest professional baseball game last by innings?
hint: The 1981 Pawtucket Red Sox game.
fact: The game was suspended after 32 innings and completed weeks later.

prompt: How long is a standard professional boxing round?
hint: Not including the one-minute rest.
fact: Championship bouts commonly contain twelve three-minute rounds.

prompt: How long does a typical Olympic opening ceremony last?
hint: Think of the main televised ceremony.
fact: The ceremony combines athlete parades, performances, and the formal opening.

prompt: How long did the Anglo-Zanzibar War last?
hint: Often called the shortest war in recorded history.
fact: It began after an ultimatum expired and ended with the bombardment of the Sultan’s palace.

prompt: How long did the First World War last?
hint: From its outbreak to the Armistice.
fact: The Armistice on 11 November 1918 ended the fighting on the Western Front.

prompt: How long did the Second World War last in Europe?
hint: From Germany’s invasion of Poland to VE Day.
fact: The war in Europe ended in May 1945, while the Pacific war continued until August.

prompt: How long did the Berlin Wall stand?
hint: From its construction to its opening in 1989.
fact: The wall became one of the clearest symbols of the Cold War.

prompt: How long did the Cuban Missile Crisis last?
hint: Count the public confrontation in October 1962.
fact: The crisis brought the United States and Soviet Union close to nuclear war.

prompt: How long was the Titanic at sea before sinking?
hint: From Southampton departure to the sinking.
fact: Titanic struck an iceberg on its maiden voyage in April 1912.

prompt: How long did the Great Fire of London burn?
hint: From its start to the last major flames.
fact: The fire destroyed thousands of homes in September 1666.

prompt: How long did the French Revolution last?
hint: Use the conventional 1789–1799 period.
fact: The Revolution transformed France’s political and social order.

prompt: How long did the Western Roman Empire conventionally last?
hint: From the traditional founding date to 476 CE.
fact: The conventional date for the western empire’s fall is 476 CE.

prompt: How long did the Apollo program run from its announcement to its final lunar mission?
hint: Use 1961 to 1972 as the program’s public span.
fact: Apollo 17 was the sixth and most recent crewed lunar landing.

prompt: How long does a typical human blink last?
hint: From eyelid closing to reopening.
fact: People blink roughly 15–20 times per minute without thinking about it.

prompt: How long can a lightning flash remain visible?
hint: Think of the full visible flash, not one microscopic return stroke.
fact: A visible lightning bolt can contain several rapid return strokes within a fraction of a second.

prompt: How long may an adult mayfly live?
hint: The adult stage can last less than a day.
fact: Most of a mayfly’s life is spent underwater as a nymph.

prompt: How long does a typical adult butterfly live?
hint: Use a broad typical range rather than a record.
fact: Lifespan varies widely between species and seasons.

prompt: How long is a typical human pregnancy?
hint: Count from the first day of the last menstrual period.
fact: Pregnancy is often described as forty weeks from the last menstrual period.

prompt: How long does a chicken egg usually take to hatch?
hint: From incubation to hatching.
fact: Temperature and breed can shift the incubation time slightly.

prompt: How long can a blue whale dive for?
hint: Use a typical long dive, not the absolute record.
fact: Blue whales surface to breathe but can make surprisingly long dives.

prompt: How long does a domestic dog typically sleep in a day?
hint: Include naps as well as night sleep.
fact: Puppies and older dogs often sleep more than healthy adults.

prompt: How long does an Atlantic salmon commonly live?
hint: Use the typical lifespan, not the oldest recorded fish.
fact: Atlantic salmon spend part of their lives in rivers and part in the ocean.

prompt: How long can a coast redwood live?
hint: Think in centuries rather than decades.
fact: Some coast redwoods are more than 2,000 years old.

prompt: How long did it take Pixar to make Toy Story?
hint: From active production through completion.
fact: It was the first feature-length film made entirely with computer animation.

prompt: How long was Avatar in production before release?
hint: Count the long development and production period.
fact: James Cameron developed the project years before its 2009 release.

prompt: How long did principal photography for The Lord of the Rings trilogy take?
hint: The three films were shot together in New Zealand.
fact: The three films were filmed back-to-back before post-production.

prompt: How long is a typical feature film?
hint: Think of a normal theatrical drama or comedy.
fact: Feature films have no single required runtime, but two hours is a useful estimate.

prompt: How long does a typical symphony performance last?
hint: Include the music, not the interval.
fact: Large symphonies often have several movements and an interval.

prompt: How long does a typical Broadway musical performance last?
hint: Include the interval.
fact: Most large musicals include one intermission.

prompt: How long did Leonardo da Vinci work on the Mona Lisa?
hint: Use the commonly cited 1503–1519 span.
fact: Leonardo is believed to have kept the painting with him for years.

prompt: How long did Michelangelo paint the Sistine Chapel ceiling?
hint: From the commission to completion.
fact: The ceiling was unveiled in 1512 after years of work above the chapel floor.

prompt: How long is a typical performance of Hamilton?
hint: Count the stage show including its interval.
fact: The musical tells the story of American founder Alexander Hamilton.

prompt: How long does it take an average reader to finish a 300-page novel?
hint: Use a comfortable recreational reading pace.
fact: Reading speed changes with text difficulty, layout, and reader experience.

prompt: How long should a typical tooth-brushing session last?
hint: The standard dental recommendation.
fact: Dentists commonly recommend brushing twice a day for two minutes.

prompt: How long should a healthy adult sleep each night?
hint: Use the usual recommended range midpoint.
fact: Most adults are advised to get roughly seven to nine hours of sleep.

prompt: How long does a soft-boiled egg usually take?
hint: Start timing once the water is boiling.
fact: Small changes in timing make a noticeable difference to the yolk.

prompt: How long does a French press coffee usually steep?
hint: From adding water to pressing the filter.
fact: A longer steep extracts more flavor but can also increase bitterness.

prompt: How long does a typical washing-machine cycle take?
hint: Use a normal everyday cycle, not a quick wash.
fact: Modern eco cycles can take longer while using less energy and water.

prompt: How long is a typical household shower?
hint: Use a normal, not especially rushed shower.
fact: Shorter showers can save a surprising amount of water.

prompt: How long does microwave popcorn usually take?
hint: From starting the microwave to the popping slowing down.
fact: The safest stopping rule is to listen for several seconds between pops.

prompt: How long can a normal dishwasher cycle take?
hint: Use a standard cycle rather than a quick wash.
fact: Energy-saving cycles often trade a longer runtime for lower water and electricity use.

prompt: How long is a classic power nap?
hint: A short nap intended to avoid deep sleep.
fact: Short naps can improve alertness without the grogginess of a longer nap.

prompt: How long does a relaxed meal at home usually take?
hint: Include eating and a little conversation.
fact: Meal length varies dramatically by culture, course count, and company.

prompt: How long does a modern nonstop transatlantic flight usually take?
hint: Use a typical Europe–North America flight.
fact: Jet streams can make the westbound and eastbound times differ substantially.

prompt: How long did a Concorde flight from London to New York take?
hint: Use the scheduled supersonic flight time.
fact: Concorde crossed the Atlantic in roughly half the time of conventional jets.

prompt: How long does a high-speed train from Beijing to Shanghai take?
hint: Use a fast direct service.
fact: The route is roughly 1,300 kilometres long.

prompt: How long does an express elevator take to reach the top of the Empire State Building?
hint: Count the ride, not the queue.
fact: High-speed elevators were part of the building’s original appeal.

prompt: How long did construction of the Three Gorges Dam take?
hint: Use the main 1994–2012 construction span.
fact: The dam is one of the world’s largest hydroelectric facilities.

prompt: How long does the Burj Khalifa elevator take to travel from ground to the observation deck?
hint: Use an express ride time.
fact: The elevators travel at speeds of more than 10 metres per second.

prompt: How long did it take to develop and build the Hubble Space Telescope?
hint: Use the long pre-launch development period.
fact: Hubble’s launch was delayed after the Challenger disaster.

prompt: How long does a careful bicycle assembly at a shop usually take?
hint: Think of a final build and safety check.
fact: Professional assembly includes adjustments that affect braking and shifting safety.

prompt: How often is the Golden Gate Bridge continuously painted?
hint: Think of ongoing maintenance, not a one-time project.
fact: Bridge painting protects steel from the marine environment.

prompt: How long can a fast charger take to charge an electric car to 80 percent?
hint: Use a modern rapid-charging session.
fact: Charging speed depends on the vehicle, charger, temperature, and battery state.

prompt: How long does Earth take to rotate once relative to the stars?
hint: Use a sidereal day.
fact: The solar day is a little longer because Earth also moves around the Sun.

prompt: How long would sound take to travel around Earth at sea level?
hint: Use the speed of sound and Earth’s circumference.
fact: Sound speed changes with temperature and the medium it travels through.

prompt: How long does it take a human cell to copy its DNA?
hint: Use a typical S-phase estimate.
fact: Human cells copy billions of DNA bases before dividing.

prompt: How long is a typical human cell cycle?
hint: Use the often-cited average for a dividing cell.
fact: Different cell types divide on very different schedules.

prompt: What is the half-life of carbon-14?
hint: Give the time in years.
fact: Carbon-14 dating works because living organisms continually exchange carbon with their environment.

prompt: How long does a litre of water take to boil on a household stove?
hint: Use a normal covered pot from room temperature.
fact: Pot size, lid use, altitude, and burner power all matter.

prompt: How long can totality last during a total solar eclipse?
hint: Use the maximum possible duration, not the whole eclipse.
fact: Most totalities are much shorter than the theoretical maximum.

prompt: How long did the 2021 Cumbre Vieja eruption last?
hint: Use the 2021 La Palma eruption.
fact: The eruption on La Palma began in September and ended in December 2021.

prompt: How long does it take light to cross a typical football field?
hint: Use the field length and the speed of light.
fact: At human scales, light crosses ordinary rooms almost instantaneously.

prompt: How long does sunlight take to travel from the Sun’s centre to its surface?
hint: Photons take a very long random-walk through the Sun.
displayAnswer: roughly thousands to millions of years
fact: Energy moves through the Sun by repeated absorption and re-emission before escaping.

prompt: How long does a fast modern web page aim to become interactive?
hint: Think of a good user experience, not a slow connection.
fact: Web performance metrics treat fast loading as an important part of usability.

prompt: How long can a modern computer take to boot to a usable desktop?
hint: Use a healthy SSD-equipped machine.
fact: Boot time depends on hardware, startup applications, and the operating system.

prompt: How long can a small data packet take to cross a local Wi-Fi network?
hint: Think of a nearby, healthy network.
fact: Latency is separate from bandwidth: a fast connection can still feel laggy.

prompt: How long should a password manager take to generate a strong password?
hint: The generation itself is nearly instant.
fact: The difficult part is storing and using a password safely, not generating it.

prompt: How long can a small 3D-printed object take to print?
hint: Use a palm-sized object on a home printer.
fact: Layer height, infill, and object geometry strongly affect print time.

prompt: How long can a modern smartphone take to fast-charge to 50 percent?
hint: Use a current fast-charging phone and charger.
fact: Charging slows near full capacity to protect the battery.

prompt: How long does a 4 GB film take to download on a 100 Mbps connection?
hint: Ignore protocol overhead and use the advertised speed.
fact: Real downloads are slower because of overhead, server limits, and Wi-Fi conditions.

prompt: How long is one cycle of a 3 GHz processor?
hint: A gigahertz is one billion cycles per second.
fact: Modern processors execute billions of clock cycles every second.

prompt: How long should a healthy video-call network delay feel?
hint: Think of end-to-end latency on a good connection.
fact: Low latency keeps conversations from feeling like people are talking over one another.

prompt: How long does a normal email take to arrive?
hint: Use a healthy modern mail system, not an urgent guarantee.
fact: Email is asynchronous, so delivery can be immediate or delayed by filtering systems.
